name: status
useFor: Use for the state of a site or a screen in a list. The pill keeps one width in every state, and changes swap the mark and word in place. Wrap it in your own `role="status"` when one status updates in place.
source: Figma "UI · Status and tags" (442:177): Verified 442:187, Processing 442:192, Queued 442:197
title: Status
description: A status pill: Verified, Loading or Queued, with a diamond or bars as its mark and the cut frame.
